page.overview:
Who is Jenova?

Jenova is an extraterrestrial life-form in the Final Fantasy VII series who serves as a major antagonist, being a central point for the series' story and crisis. Experiments conducted on its cells, done by the Research & Development Department of the Shinra Electric Power Company, have produced many of the setting's adversaries, key among them Sephiroth.

Throughout Final Fantasy VII, Jenova is often referred to as "she", though Ifalna calls the entity "he" (or "it" in the PC version). This alien has a humanoid feminine form and is said to be the "mother" of Sephiroth.

The Cetra called Jenova by many names: "cataclysm from the stars", "calamity from the skies", "crisis from the sky" , or "heaven's dark harbinger".

A dormant Jenova appears as a gray-skinned woman with a "scaly" skin (shown as blue-skinned in Final Fantasy VII or only appearing blue through its container in the mako reactor on Mt. Nibel in other games). Jenova appears feminine, and is consistently called "mother" by Sephiroth, though is ultimately an extra-terrestrial lifeform. Jenova is known as the "calamity from the skies" in the legends and, in Final Fantasy VII, Ifalna refers to Jenova as either "it" or "he" depending on the version of the game.

Also known as: Calamity from the Skies, Jenova Project.
